historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base_case_forward_10yr_revenue_cagr -- every historical CAGR describes a growth story that has broken (Q3-2026 guided to the first-ever YoY decline); equity CAGR is distorted by $2.6B of buybacks since FY2023
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3y CAGR 5.5% vs revenue 3y CAGR 22.4% and EPS 3y CAGR 102% (off a FY2022 EPS of $0.11): divergence far above 30%. Equity is suppressed by buybacks, EPS is off a depressed base -- neither is a usable forward anchor, and revenue growth itself is now negative.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - equity-award withholding taxes - net interest income) was NEGATIVE in FY2021-FY2024, partly because of the CEO Performance Option amortisation, so a 3y owner-FCF CAGR is undefined; the 5y owner-FCF CAGR is -3.5% against a reported-FCF 5y CAGR of +19.2%. Almost all of the reported FCF growth was paid for in stock. Reported-FCF CAGRs are shown for reference only.

scenario_narratives.base: Cyclical-plus-structural reset: 2026 is the trough (Y1 revenue -5.5% from the Q3 guide of >=$650M), growth recovers to ~7% by Y4-Y5 on CTV/retail media and Kokai, then fades to 3.5%; adj. EBITDA margin recovers from ~25% to a 36% plateau (5pp below the FY2025 peak) on post-RIF costs, SBC incl. withholding taxes fades from 16% to 11% of revenue. TTD ends as a mid-single-digit grower with a smaller wallet share as walled gardens take performance budgets.
scenario_narratives.bull: Recovery: the 2026 slump proves mostly cyclical and migration-driven; Kokai performance, JBP growth, international CTV and Ventura bring growth back to low-teens by Y3-Y4 and margins to 42% on the leaner cost base. Founder buying at ~$24.68 is consistent with this case. Requires macro, competition and execution to all turn, so weighted 20%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Structural share loss to Amazon DSP (with Netflix inventory) and Google DV360: revenue falls another ~13% over two years, growth never re-accelerates past ~3%, take-rate pressure and sticky retention SBC hold margins in the high-20s, and governance churn persists. Net cash and positive owner FCF mean survival, not distress -- the floor is a cheap ex-growth ad-tech utility.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value TTD as what it has become in 2026 -- a cash-generative but ex-hypergrowth independent DSP facing walled-garden competition -- not as the 25%-growth compounder of 2017-2024. Owner FCF fully charges SBC and the cash taxes on net-share settlement, strips interest on the $1.5B cash pile, and builds margins from components off a trough year rather than the FY2025 peak. Recovery is held as optionality in a 20%-weighted bull case, not baked into the base.
key_risks_to_valuation: Revenue trough depth: Q3-2026 guided -12% YoY with 'limited visibility'; a second year of decline moves the base toward the bear case
Take-rate / pricing power: Amazon DSP's low-fee, retail-data offering (now with Netflix inventory) could force platform-fee cuts that cap the margin recovery
SBC persistence: retention grants after an ~80% drawdown could keep SBC near 15%+ of revenue, the single largest owner-FCF deduction
Governance and guidance credibility: four CFOs in ~14 months and successive 2026 misses lower confidence in every forward input
Upside: TTD has historically beaten its own guidance; a cyclical ad recovery plus Kokai gains could make the base case conservative, and the founder bought ~$148M of stock at ~2x today's price

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular close); 52-week range 11.85-56.39. To be refreshed at the next regular close.
data_sources.financials: SEC XBRL companyfacts (CIK 1671933): FY2020-FY2025 10-Ks and Q1/Q2 2026 10-Qs; research/TTD/Reports/TTD_Metrics.csv and TTD.duckdb core_metrics/kpis
data_sources.qualitative: research/TTD/Reports/TTD_Analysis.json (2026-10-02): Q3-2026 revenue guide >=$650M and adj. EBITDA ~$160M, Sept-2026 RIF ($39-51M charges), S&P 500 removal 2026-09-21, CFO turnover, CEO share purchase March 2026

inputs.share_count_basis: Q2 2026 10-Q diluted weighted-average shares (469.948M; basic 468.4M). Held FLAT because SBC (plus equity-award withholding taxes) is fully expensed in the flows; charging dilution too would double-count. Most options are far out of the money at ~$12, so the diluted count is close to basic. Buybacks continued in Q3 2026 at depressed prices, so the period-end count is likely lower -- conservative.
inputs.cash_note: 30-Jun-2026 balance sheet (Q2 2026 10-Q): cash & equivalents $1,123.0M + short-term investments $362.4M. No funded debt (revolver undrawn). Operating lease liabilities (~$436M at Dec-2025) excluded from net debt because US-GAAP operating lease cost already sits inside adjusted EBITDA (one lease treatment).
inputs.sbc_source: SEC XBRL (10-K FY2025, 10-Q Q2 2026), TTM to 30-Jun-2026: ShareBasedCompensation cash-flow add-back $452.1M + PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation $61.4M. TTD publishes no combined SBC-incl-taxes figure in its adj. EBITDA reconciliation, so the two lines are summed.
inputs.buyback_note: TTM to Jun-2026 PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock (FY2025 $1,380.4M; H1-2026 $241.3M). TTD is an active repurchaser, so the flat share count is being funded, not a modelling convention.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Cost of equity = 4.3% US 10y + beta 1.35 x 5.0% ERP = 11.05% -> 11.0%. Beta blends TTD's own ~1.5 five-year beta with ~1.2 for ad-tech peers. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate in every scenario: the business-model risk (share loss to Amazon/Google, governance) is charged once, through the bear weight and driver paths, not via a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (US GAAP ASC 842): lease cost sits in opex, so inside adj. EBITDA; lease liabilities NOT in net debt. lease_cost_pct_path = 0.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing: operating company, US ad-tech platform; not a bank/REIT/holdco; net cash, no solvency risk, so not a distressed/asset model). First valuation of TTD (no MEMORY entry). FY0 is TTM to 30-Jun-2026 (revenue $2,990.1M = FY25 $2,896.3M - H1-25 $1,310.1M + H1-26 $1,403.9M) so the flows start where the 30-Jun-2026 balance sheet ends; Y1 = Jul-2026..Jun-2027. TTM adj. EBITDA (op income $586.3M + D&A $126.7M + SBC $452.1M) = $1,165.1M, 39.0% margin, but H1-2026 alone was 31.9% and Q3-2026 guidance (~$160M on >=$650M) is ~25% -- the TTM figure is NOT the forward base. TTM owner FCF $294.1M (= $863.0M OCF-less-PP&E - $513.5M SBC incl. withholding taxes - $55.4M net interest income) is flattered by a receivables-led working-capital release as gross spend shrinks (H1-26 AR -$548M vs AP -$428M); FY2025 owner FCF was $138.7M. Interest income is stripped because net cash ($1.49B) is ~5x the owner-FCF base. Y1 revenue is built bottom-up from guidance: Q3-26 ~$660M (guide >=$650M, -11%), Q4-26 ~$760M (-10%), Q1-27 ~$680M, Q2-27 ~$720M -> ~$2,825M, -5.5% vs TTM. Y1 margin also absorbs ~$45M of cash severance from the Sept-2026 15% RIF (guided $39-51M), which adj. EBITDA would exclude. Historical hypergrowth (5y revenue CAGR 28%) is deliberately NOT extrapolated.

bear.narrative: Structural share loss. Amazon DSP (with Netflix inventory) and DV360 take performance and CTV budgets the independent DSP cannot match on first-party retail data; the Q3 decline extends into a second down year, agencies re-negotiate take rates, and growth never re-accelerates past low single digits. Leadership churn (four CFOs in 14 months) keeps execution erratic, margins stall in the high-20s and SBC stays sticky because talent must be retained after an 80% drawdown. The business survives on net cash and positive owner FCF, but as an ex-growth ad-tech utility.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 -5.5% bottom-up from Q3-26 guide and a similar Q4 decline; Y2 +3% as comps ease; recovery to 7% in Y4-Y5 on CTV/retail-media secular growth but well below the 18-26% of FY2024-25, reflecting structural share loss to Amazon DSP (Netflix inventory) and DV360; fades to 3.5%.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Adj. EBITDA (pre-SBC) 39% TTM but ~25% in Q3-26 guidance. Y1 26.5% nets the ~$45M severance; RIF savings lift to 30-34% by Y2-Y4, plateauing at 36% -- 5pp below the FY2025 41% peak because the take-rate/pricing power that funded it is under competitive pressure.
base.sbc_pct_rationale: Includes equity-award withholding taxes. TTM 17.2% (15.1% SBC + 2.1% taxes). Y1 16% on the Q3 SBC reversal and lower vest-date values; fades 0.5-1pp/yr to 11% -- still heavy for ad-tech, because retention grants after an 80% drawdown are a real cost.
base.capex_rationale: PP&E plus capitalised software. FY2025 6.8% and H1-26 9.0% were inflated by data-centre/Ventura build; fades to 4.5%, just above D&A at maturity.
base.tax_rationale: FY2025 cash taxes $150.1M on $658.8M pretax (22.8%); the GAAP ETR is ~33-45% from SBC shortfalls at a falling share price. Cash rate 25% near term, 23% at maturity.
base.wc_rationale: Gross-billing ad platform: receivables exceed payables, so growth consumes cash (FY2023-24 OCF ran $150-240M below NI+SBC+D&A) and a decline releases it. -20% of the revenue change.
base.narrative: Cyclical-plus-structural reset. 2026 is the trough; Kokai migration friction fades, the RIF restores margins to the mid-30s, and CTV keeps growing, but TTD settles as a mid-single-digit grower with a smaller share of the open-internet/CTV wallet as walled gardens take performance budgets.

bull.narrative: Recovery. The 2026 decline proves mostly cyclical (tariffs, CPG/auto budgets) and migration-driven; Kokai's CPA gains and agentic features win back agency JBP budgets, international CTV (50%+) and retail media compound, and Ventura gives TTD a TV-OS supply path. Growth rebuilds to low-teens by Y3-Y4, margins pass the FY2025 peak to 42% on the leaner post-RIF cost base, and SBC normalises to 9%. Jeff Green's $148M buy at ~$24.68 is the insider's version of this case. Still requires macro, competition and execution to go right together, which is why it is weighted at only 20%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% because the thesis now rests on an unproven turnaround: a guided first-ever revenue decline, repeated 2026 guidance misses, four CFOs in 14 months and a credible structural competitor (Amazon DSP + Netflix). Base held at 50% because net cash of ~$1.5B and positive owner FCF rule out solvency risk. Bull cut to 20% because it needs macro, competitive position and execution to improve together.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
